subject: Media Literacy
title: Living with Bias: A Balanced Approach
description: A quick, practical guide to Living with Bias: A Balanced Approach.

hook.text: Some people become so aware of media bias that they trust nothing at all. That's not literacy — it's paralysis.

buildup.text: Healthy media literacy means engaging critically without becoming cynical. Skepticism isn't the same as nihilism.

discovery.text: The goal is calibrated trust — knowing which sources are reliable for what, and adjusting confidence accordingly.

twist.text: Total distrust serves disinformation as much as blind trust does. Both leave you unable to act on real information.

climax.text: Media literacy isn't about trusting nothing. It's about knowing how much to trust, and why.

punchline.text: Trust less blindly. But don't stop trusting entirely.

quiz.question: Why is total distrust of all media counterproductive?
options: It leaves you unable to act on real information, which serves disinformation
